title: What is a bank?
author: Kirpini OrangeVillager2
pages: Banks are the backbone of every village. They build emerald golems, distribute food, and provide a place for villagers to sell the products of their work.
The primary role of the bank is to hoard emeralds to build emerald golems to defend the village. Thus, all emeralds that villagers obtain end up here.

Trading with banks might be your main source of emeralds. Item prices are dependent on how many they need to help the village function. Surplus items are cheap to buy and sell, items in demand are expensive.

Furthermore, trading with villagers moves emeralds from the bank directly to you and to the bank. Thus, despite the ability of villagers to summon items out of thin area, they cannot do them with emeralds.
You can gain favor with banks by donating items that they need, rather than making them pay. This might get you access to unique trades.
Meanwhile, they get upset if you break into their chests, attack their employees, or any of their emerald creations. Anger them at your own risk.
